name: derma-shield
description: DERMA-SHIELD — Optical ITA° melanin & erythema scanner, ABCDE lesion morphometry caliper, solar UV burn vs. vitamin D3 dosimeter and sunscreen photostability auditor. Svelte + JavaScript + Python 3.12 + Kotlin + GLSL. Zero TypeScript.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.audit:all: node scripts/audit-typescript.mjs && python3 python_photobiology/selftest.py && node scripts/parity-check.mjs --quick && npm run build
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
